svg.title: The Midnight AI Vampire — scene roster
svg.desc: The same original vampire in all fifteen scenes of the profile, each with the power of its chamber: scene 01 Hero (Hero); scene 02 Shadow King (About); scene 03 Ai Master (Ai / Ml); scene 04 Coder (Terminal); scene 05 Flashdrop Portal (Flashdrop); scene 06 Data Sorcerer (Skills); scene 07 Project Commander (Projects); scene 08 Time Keeper (Experience); scene 09 Knowledge Keeper (Education); scene 10 Github Guardian (Github); scene 11 Void Walker (Transition); scene 12 Teleportation (Transition); scene 13 Power Awakening (Prologue); scene 14 Silhouette (Footer); scene 15 Final Guardian (Contact); Power 09 Digital Clones (Skills).
